name: HaitiDocs
description: HaitiDocs MCP is a curated, read-only knowledge server for Haiti. It provides structured access to economic indicators, published documents, maps, development projects, disaster risk information, and current Haiti-related news. Responses include source attribution, publication dates, and citations, making it well suited for research, policy analysis, and evidence-based questions about Haiti.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HaitiDocs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HaitiDocs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.haitidocs.org/.

_published_faq.name: Is HaitiDocs MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, HaitiDocs scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HaitiDocs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HaitiDocs provides these MCP tools: fetch, fetch_many, fetch_map_layer, get_passages, list_documents, search, and server_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HaitiDocs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HaitiDocs in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
HaitiDocs does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
HaitiDocs is developed by HaitiDocs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
